The main takeaway from our work is that
the maxmin multi-utility approach is well-suited to the study of preference relations that may be incomplete and/or nontransitive.
a utility representation of a preference relation can be viewed as a multi-utility representation of its indifference relation.
the utility representation theorem is robust to the incompleteness and intransitivity that are often present in the empirical data.
